brief: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000.

requirements.evidence: The existing full base (piece:0,0,0;full) is still there, but I added nothing to it because the drawer you asked for doesn't exist.

No part by that name exists. A search for 'turbo' found nothing, and the only drawer styles are classic, slide, swing, long and longbin, plus the notch and bay drawer frames. No drawer can fit the current build either: a base drawer needs a half base, and notch and bay drawers need two or three bases side by side.

finish.summary: I didn't build this because Hex Cluster has no part called "hex-turbo-drawer-9000". A search of the catalog for "turbo" found nothing. A search for "drawer" found only notch drawer frames (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf/-fm, plus double-height -x2 versions) and bay drawer frames (hex-drawer-frame-bay-n/-s, plus -x2 versions). Drawers that fit a base aren't in the catalog: they come in five styles (classic, slide, swing, long, longbin), and none of them is a "turbo" or "9000". I didn't fit a different drawer in its place because that would be a different part from the one you asked for. The build is as it was: the single full base at (0,0,0). If you'd like a real drawer, I can do one of two things. I can swap that base for a half base and fit a drawer on its cut face in any of the five styles. Or I can add bases beside it to make room for a notch or bay drawer.
